sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于查出了她的名字叫艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: He pressed a fingertip to the phone's rotary dial and turned its wheel until it hit the stop position.
sentences.zh: 他将指尖按在电话的转盘上，转动转盘直到它停在卡位上。

sentences.en: He repeated this motion over and over, until he had spun each digit of the Oceanside Police Department's phone number.
sentences.zh: 他一遍又一遍地重复这个动作，直到拨完欧申赛德警察局电话号码的每一位数字。

sentences.en: I am going to pull something here in Oceanside, he warned the answering officer.
sentences.zh: 我打算在欧申赛德搞点事情，他向接线警员警告道。

sentences.en: And you will never be able to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 而且你们永远也查不出来。

sentences.en: The following night, 29-year-old Oceanside cab driver Ray Davis pulled up at a downtown taxi stand on Mission Avenue.
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，29岁的欧申赛德出租车司机雷·戴维斯将车停在使命大道的市中心出租车候客点。

sentences.en: At 11.10, a customer approached his vehicle and climbed into the back seat.
sentences.zh: 11点10分，一名乘客走近他的车并坐进了后座。

sentences.en: Ray radioed his dispatcher to inform that he'd just picked up a fare and was headed for South Pacific Street.
sentences.zh: 雷通过无线电向调度员报告说，他刚接了一单，正前往南太平洋街。

sentences.en: He didn't report back or respond to any further radio communications.
sentences.zh: 他没有再回电，也没有回复任何后续的无线电通话。

sentences.en: After a considerable amount of time had passed with no contact from Ray, his employer notified police.
sentences.zh: 在与雷失联很长一段时间后，他的雇主报了警。

sentences.en: A beach patrol discovered Ray's lifeless body later that morning in an alley off South Pacific Street, in the upscale neighbourhood of St. Mallow.
sentences.zh: 当天上午晚些时候，海滩巡逻队在圣马洛高档社区南太平洋街的一条小巷里发现了雷毫无生气的尸体。

sentences.en: The 11.10 kerbside pickup was Ray's last job for Checker Cab Company, his employer of less than four months.
sentences.zh: 11点10分的这次路边载客是雷为捷克出租车公司完成的最后一次业务，他在该公司工作还不到四个月。

sentences.en: At some point during this trip, Ray's passenger pulled out a gun and fired it into the driver's seat, hitting Ray in the back.
sentences.zh: 在这趟行程中的某个时刻，雷的乘客掏出一把枪朝驾驶座开枪，击中了雷的背部。

sentences.en: The shooter then aimed at Ray's head and pulled the trigger.
sentences.zh: 随后，枪手瞄准雷的头部并扣动了扳机。

sentences.en: The third and final bullet punctured the windshield, missing Ray completely.
sentences.zh: 第三发也是最后一发子弹击穿了挡风玻璃，完全没有打中雷。

sentences.en: Two .22 caliber long rifle bullets were recovered from Ray's body.
sentences.zh: 法医从雷的体内取出了两颗.22口径长步枪子弹。

sentences.en: Despite their name, long rifle bullets could also be used in handguns.
sentences.zh: 顾名思义，长步枪子弹也可以用于手枪。

sentences.en: Ray's cab was found abandoned in an alley one and a half miles up the road.
sentences.zh: 雷的出租车被发现遗弃在前方一英里半的一条小巷里。

sentences.en: It appeared as though his killer had used the vehicle to facilitate a quicker getaway.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎利用这辆车来更快地逃跑。

sentences.en: Police were puzzled by the seemingly motiveless crime.
sentences.zh: 这起看似毫无动机的犯罪让警方感到十分困惑。

sentences.en: Ray hadn't been robbed.
sentences.zh: 雷并没有被抢劫。

sentences.en: His wallet had been left behind, as had a small amount of change in his shirt pocket.
sentences.zh: 他的钱包留在了车里，衬衫口袋里的一些零钱也原封不动。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, unrelated armed robberies were examined for possible links.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是排查了其他无关的武装抢劫案，以寻找可能的联系。

sentences.en: None were found.
sentences.zh: 但没有发现任何联系。

sentences.en: Both evidence and persons of interest were limited.
sentences.zh: 无论是物证还是重点嫌疑人都非常有限。

sentences.en: Ray was relatively new to Oceanside, having moved there with his brother just four months earlier.
sentences.zh: 雷来到欧申赛德不久，四个月前才和兄弟一起搬到这里。

sentences.en: He didn't have the community connections necessary to pad out a suspect liSt.
sentences.zh: 他没有足够的人脉来列出一份厚厚的嫌疑人名单。

sentences.en: Most of the individuals questioned were known petty criminals who were quickly ruled out.
sentences.zh: 受讯问的大多数人都是知名的惯偷，很快就被排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: A fellow cabbie was also looked into, but accusations against him proved baseless.
sentences.zh: 警方还调查了一位同行的出租车司机，但针对他的指控被证实毫无根据。

sentences.en: Then, four days after Ray Davis' murder, a second anonymous call was placed to Oceanside PD.
sentences.zh: 接着，在雷·戴维斯遇害四天后，欧申赛德警察局接到了第二个匿名电话。

sentences.en: Do you remember me calling you and telling you that I was going to pull a real baffling crime?
sentences.zh: 你还记得我给你打过电话，说我要干一桩真正让人摸不着头脑的案子吗？

sentences.en: The caller asked.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人问道。

sentences.en: I killed the cab driver, and I'm going to get me a bus driver next.
sentences.zh: 我杀死了那个出租车司机，接下来我要干掉一个公交车司机。

sentences.en: Oceanside Police took this very seriously.
sentences.zh: 欧申赛德警方对此高度重视。

sentences.en: They had kept word of the initial call they received on April 9 under wraps, so they were certain they weren't dealing with a copycat or hoax.
sentences.zh: 他们对4月9日接到第一个电话的消息保密得严严实实，因此他们确信这不是恶作剧或模仿作案。

sentences.en: The caller had made good on his first threat by murdering Ray Davis, so there was a very real possibility he would follow through with the second.
sentences.zh: 来电者通过谋杀雷·戴维斯兑现了他的第一个威胁，所以他很有可能会兑现第二个威胁。

sentences.en: Faced with an unpredictable killer, the city manager gave officials blanket authority to take whatever steps necessary to protect Oceanside's 25 bus drivers.
sentences.zh: 面对一个不可预测的凶手，城市经理赋予了官员全权，采取一切必要措施保护欧申赛德的25名公交车司机。

sentences.en: Buses and bus stops were placed under close observation.
sentences.zh: 公交车和公交车站受到了严密监视。

sentences.en: At night, military police from the nearby Marine Corps base camp stood guard over the nervous drivers, on the lookout for any suspicious passengers.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，来自附近海军陆战队基地的宪兵在紧张的司机身旁站岗放哨，留意任何可疑的乘客。

sentences.en: Four days after the second threat was made, a woman answered her telephone to hear a man warn,
sentences.zh: 发出第二个威胁四天后，一名女性接听电话，听到一个男子警告说：

sentences.en: Tonight is the night I'm going to kill that bus driver.
sentences.zh: 今晚就是我干掉那个公交车司机的日子。

sentences.en: The caller didn't give his name, but told the woman to relay the message to the police.
sentences.zh: 来电者没有透露姓名，但要求这名女子将消息转告警方。

sentences.en: They listened to her claim, while also being mindful that the case's notoriety would likely appeal to pranksters and attention seekers.
sentences.zh: 警方听取了她的陈述，同时也注意到此案的恶劣影响可能会吸引恶作剧者和哗众取宠之徒。

sentences.en: The chaos was making headlines across the city, but concerns dissipated when the killer failed to carry out his second threat.
sentences.zh: 这起混乱事件登上了全市各大媒体的头条，但随着凶手未能实施他的第二个威胁，人们的担忧也随之消散。

sentences.en: As a precaution, two drivers were assigned to all buses that travelled lonely routes.
sentences.zh: 作为预防措施，所有行驶在偏僻路线上的公交车都配备了两名司机。

sentences.en: But for the most part, life in Oceanside returned to normal.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，欧申赛德的生活恢复了正常。

sentences.en: Eventually, the Ray Davis case went cold.
sentences.zh: 最终，雷·戴维斯案成为了一桩悬案。

sentences.en: At the time of his death, he was estranged from his wife and had no children.
sentences.zh: 他去世时与妻子分居，且没有孩子。

sentences.en: He was close to his brother and mother, but when they died many years later,
sentences.zh: 他和兄弟以及母亲关系很近，但多年后他们相继离世，

sentences.en: Ray's senseless murder faded from California's memory.
sentences.zh: 雷这起毫无意义的谋杀案也渐渐淡出了加利福尼亚人的记忆。

sentences.en: Decades later, in 2018, local historian Christy Hawthorne donned a pair of white cotton gloves and began flipping through archived newspapers at an Oceanside museum.
sentences.zh: 几十年后的2018年，当地历史学家克里斯蒂·霍索恩戴上一副白棉手套，开始在欧申赛德博物馆翻阅存档的报纸。

sentences.en: She had lived in the city since 1983 and harboured a deep passion for preserving its history.
sentences.zh: 她自1983年以来一直居住在这座城市，并且对保护其历史怀有极大的热情。

sentences.en: Christy was researching the St Mallow area when a three-word, front-page headline caught her attention.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂当时正在研究圣马洛地区，一则三个字的头版新闻标题吸引了她的注意。

sentences.en: Written in large, bold letters across a yellowed copy of the Daily Blade Tribune were the words,
sentences.zh: 在泛黄的《每日刀锋论坛报》上，醒目的粗体大字写着：

sentences.en: Local cabbie slain.
sentences.zh: 当地出租车司机遇害。

sentences.en: Dated Wednesday, April 11, 1962, the accompanying article detailed the circumstances of Ray Davis' murder.
sentences.zh: 文章日期为1962年4月11日星期三，随后的报道详细描述了雷·戴维斯遇害的经过。

sentences.en: Christy was unfamiliar with the case, which had occurred more than half a century earlier.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂对这起发生半个多世纪前的案件并不熟悉。

sentences.en: As she read on, her heartbeat quickened.
sentences.zh: 随着她继续往下读，她的心跳加快了。

sentences.en: A cab driver, a .22 calibre firearm, long rifle ammunition, a city with a water-based name, a waterside crime scene, its proximity to a military base,
sentences.zh: 一名出租车司机、一把.22口径枪械、长步枪弹药、一个以水命名的城市、一个水边犯罪现场、临近军事基地，

sentences.en: lack of a motive or suspects, the randomness of the attack, and, most intriguing of all, a cryptic killer who taunted the police.
sentences.zh: 缺乏动机或嫌疑人、袭击的随机性，以及最引人注目的——一个戏弄警方的神秘凶手。

sentences.en: Alarm bells rang in Christy's mind.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂心中警铃大作。

sentences.en: This seemed all too familiar.
sentences.zh: 这一切显得太熟悉了。

sentences.en: Daybreak on Sunday, June 2, 1963, one year after the murder of Ray Davis, near Gaviota, California.
sentences.zh: 1963年6月2日星期日黎明，雷·戴维斯遇害一年后，加利福尼亚州加维奥塔附近。

sentences.en: The sharp crack of gunshots echoed across the rolling landscape of Santa Barbara County.
sentences.zh: 清脆的枪声在圣巴巴拉县起伏的山峦间回荡。

sentences.en: Three teenagers who were camping alongside Tejiga's Creek were alarmed by the unmistakable noise.
sentences.zh: 三名在特希加溪旁露营的青少年被这辨识度极高的声音惊动了。

sentences.en: It sounded as though the shots were fired just south of their location, where the creek filtered into the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 听起来枪声似乎来自他们所在位置的正南方，也就是小溪汇入太平洋的地方。

sentences.en: There were no subsequent reports of damage or harm.
sentences.zh: 随后没有出现任何财产损失或人员受伤的报告。

sentences.en: It seemed as if the shooter had been firing for no reason at all.
sentences.zh: 看起来开枪的人似乎毫无理由地在盲目射击。

sentences.en: Later that same day,
sentences.zh: 就在同一天晚些时候，

sentences.en: 11 teenagers were enjoying a day of surf and sand at a beach adjacent to Gaviota State Park, just seven miles west of Tejiga's Creek.
sentences.zh: 11名青少年在距离特希加溪以西仅七英里的加维奥塔州立公园附近的海滩上享受冲浪和沙滩的乐趣。

sentences.en: By mid-afternoon, the teens had made their way back to the secluded spot just off Highway 101, where they'd parked their cars.
sentences.zh: 到了下午中期，这群青少年返回了101号高速公路旁他们停车的偏僻地点。

sentences.en: As they huddled around chatting, a loud cracking sound startled them.
sentences.zh: 正当他们聚在一起聊天时，一声巨响吓了他们一跳。

sentences.en: The noise was accompanied by a high-pitched whirr as something small flew right by them.
sentences.zh: 伴随着噪音的是高频的呼啸声，有什么小东西从他们身旁飞过。

sentences.en: It was a bullet.
sentences.zh: 那是一颗子弹。

sentences.en: Another quickly followed.
sentences.zh: 紧接着又飞来一颗。

sentences.en: No one was hit, but the teens were left shaken.
sentences.zh: 没有人中弹，但这些年轻人吓得不轻。

sentences.en: They never caught sight of the shooter.
sentences.zh: 他们自始至终没有看到枪手的身影。

sentences.en: Two days later, on Tuesday June 4,
sentences.zh: 两天后的6月4日星期二，

sentences.en: 18-year-old Robert Dominguez was at the wheel of his family's 1956 Pontiac.
sentences.zh: 18岁的罗伯特·多明格斯正开着家里的一辆1956年产庞蒂亚克轿车。

sentences.en: Sitting beside him was his childhood sweetheart-turned-fiancée,
sentences.zh: 坐在他身旁的是他的青梅竹马兼未婚妻，

sentences.en: 17-year-old Linda Edwards.
sentences.zh: 17岁的琳达·爱德华兹。

sentences.en: It was a special occasion for the pair.
sentences.zh: 对这对情侣来说这是一个特殊的日子。

sentences.en: Both were senior students at Lompoc High School and were due to graduate later in the week.
sentences.zh: 两人都是隆波克高中的高三学生，本周晚些时候即将毕业。

sentences.en: That Tuesday was a ditch day, an official day off from classes for the graduating seniors.
sentences.zh: 那个星期二是一个“逃课日”，是官方允许即将毕业的高三学生放假一天。

sentences.en: While their peers partied together, Robert and Linda decided to spend their free afternoon at a secluded beach near Gaviota State Park.
sentences.zh: 当同龄人们聚在一起狂欢时，罗伯特和琳达决定在加维奥塔州立公园附近一处偏僻的海滩度过他们的自由下午。

sentences.en: Linda had an additional reason to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 琳达还有一个庆祝的理由。

sentences.en: Her 18th birthday was just three days away.
sentences.zh: 她的18岁生日就在三天后。

sentences.en: It was around midday when the young couple hit the road for their trip to the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 正午时分，这对年轻情侣踏上了前往海岸的旅程。

sentences.en: They reached Gaviota before continuing another four miles down Highway 101 to a dirt turnout that provided a good spot to pull over.
sentences.zh: 他们到达加维奥塔，然后沿101号高速公路继续行驶四英里，来到一个适合停车的泥泞路边岔道。

sentences.en: After stripping down to their bathing suits, Robert and Linda crossed the road and began the arduous trek down the hill to the beachfront below.
sentences.zh: 换上泳衣后，罗伯特和琳达穿过公路，开始艰难地向下跋涉，前往下方山坡的海滩。

sentences.en: Once there, they unravelled a blanket on a small patch of sand and laid down together.
sentences.zh: 到达后，他们在小片沙地上铺开一条毯子，并肩躺下。

sentences.en: With no one else in sight, Robert and Linda believed they had the entire area to themselves.
sentences.zh: 周围看不到其他人，罗伯特和琳达以为整个区域只有他们两个。

sentences.en: They were wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们想错了。

sentences.en: A man suddenly appeared before them.
sentences.zh: 一个男人突然出现在他们面前。

sentences.en: He handed Linda a piece of rope and ordered that she tie Robert's hands behind his back.
sentences.zh: 他递给琳达一截绳子，命令她把罗伯特的双手反绑在身后。

sentences.en: Terrified, she did as she was told.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的她照做了。

sentences.en: She didn't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 她别无选择。

sentences.en: The man was holding a gun.
sentences.zh: 那个人手里拿着枪。

sentences.en: Once Robert was under control, the man set about restraining Linda.
sentences.zh: 一旦控制住罗伯特，这名男子便开始绑琳达。

sentences.en: Before he could loop the rope and pull it tight, he was tackled by Robert, who had managed to wriggle free from his ligature.
sentences.zh: 还没等他把绳子套好并拉紧，罗伯特就猛扑过来将他扑倒，罗伯特刚刚已经设法挣脱了束缚。

sentences.en: An altercation ensued.
sentences.zh: 双方随即发生了扭打。

sentences.en: Despite sustaining several bruise-inducing blows to the face, Robert managed to overpower his opponent.
sentences.zh: 尽管脸部挨了好几拳并受了伤，罗伯特还是设法制服了对手。

sentences.en: He and Linda then ran for their lives.
sentences.zh: 随后他和琳达夺路而逃。

sentences.en: The gunman scrambled to his feet.
sentences.zh: 持枪歹徒从地上爬了起来。

sentences.en: The two teens hadn't gotten far.
sentences.zh: 两个年轻人并没有跑出多远。

sentences.en: The only way out was up and the rugged hillside was slowing their escape.
sentences.zh: 唯一的逃生路线是往上爬，而崎岖的山坡减慢了他们逃跑的速度。

sentences.en: The attacker raised his gun and took aim.
sentences.zh: 袭击者举起枪瞄准。

sentences.en: He fired over and over until the chamber was empty and his targets had fallen.
sentences.zh: 他不停地开枪，直到弹匣打空，目标倒地。

sentences.en: He reloaded, then marched intently to where his victims lay bleeding in the sand.
sentences.zh: 他重新装上子弹，然后径直走向躺在沙里流血的受害者。

sentences.en: He then shot them both several more times at close range.
sentences.zh: 接着，他又近距离朝两人各开了好几枪。

sentences.en: Robert was shot 11 times.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特身上中了11枪。

sentences.en: Linda ate.
sentences.zh: 琳达也未能幸免。

sentences.en: After the slaughter, the shooter dragged Robert's body 30 feet across the rough terrain to a driftwood shack hidden in the bushes.
sentences.zh: 屠杀过后，凶手拖着罗伯特的尸体穿过30英尺的崎岖地形，来到灌木丛中隐藏的一个浮木小屋。

sentences.en: He pulled Robert inside, before collecting Linda and dumping her on top of her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 他把罗伯特拉进屋里，然后把琳达抱过来压在她男友身上。

sentences.en: He then cut Linda's bathing suit open with a knife, exposing her breasts.
sentences.zh: 随后，他用刀划开琳达的泳衣，露出了她的胸部。

sentences.en: It was easy to pull down the shack's dilapidated roof to conceal the bodies.
sentences.zh: 推倒小屋破旧的屋顶来掩盖尸体易如反掌。

sentences.en: After stacking further debris on top, the killer lit several matches and threw them at a tarpaulin covering the shack's entrance.
sentences.zh: 在堆积了更多杂物后，凶手划了几根火柴，扔在盖着小屋入口的防水布上。

sentences.en: It was time to leave.
sentences.zh: 是时候离开了。

sentences.en: The fire would take care of the reSt.
sentences.zh: 大火会处理掉剩下的痕迹。

sentences.en: It was nearing 10 o'clock the following night when California Highway Patrol Officer Paul Schultz drove along Highway 101, 22 miles southwest of Lompoc.
sentences.zh: 次日晚近10点时，加州公路巡警保罗·舒尔茨驾驶巡逻车行驶在隆波克西南22英里处的101号高速公路上。

sentences.en: The area was quiet, save for the sound of the sea crashing against the coastline.
sentences.zh: 周围一片寂静，只有海水拍打海岸的声音。

sentences.en: Officer Schultz approached a stretch of roadway south of Gaviota State Park, where three men were standing by the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 舒尔茨警官驶近加维奥塔州立公园以南的一段路段，那里有三个人正站在路边。

sentences.en: One was George Dominguez, who was out looking for his son, Robert.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是乔治·多明格斯，他出来寻找自己的儿子罗伯特。

sentences.en: No one had heard from Robert or his fiancée, Linda, since they left for the beach the day before.
sentences.zh: 自从前一天两人动身去海滩以来，再也没有人听到过罗伯特或他的未婚妻琳达的消息。

sentences.en: George Dominguez had gathered a small search party at the teen's last known location.
sentences.zh: 乔治·多明格斯在青少年最后已知的位置组织了一支小型搜救队。

sentences.en: They had since made an important discovery.
sentences.zh: 此后他们有了一个重要发现。

sentences.en: The men led Officer Schultz to a turnout off the highway.
sentences.zh: 几名男子将舒尔茨警官带到高速公路旁的一个路边岔道。

sentences.en: Parked in the dirt by some bushes was the Dominguez family's Pontiac.
sentences.zh: 多明格斯一家的庞蒂亚克轿车停在灌木丛旁的泥土地里。

sentences.en: The doors were locked.
sentences.zh: 车门锁着。

sentences.en: Three empty soda bottles were spotted within.
sentences.zh: 车内隐约可见三个空苏打水瓶。

sentences.en: Linda's purse lay on the floor in the front, and her and Robert's clothing was strewn about in the back.
sentences.zh: 琳达的手提包落在前排地板上，她和罗伯特的衣服则散落在后座。

sentences.en: This confirmed the couple had made it to the beach, but they hadn't returned to the vehicle since.
sentences.zh: 这证实这对情侣确实到了海滩，但之后再也没有回过车上。

sentences.en: One of George's companions informed Officer Schultz that there was a makeshift shack on the nearby beach, where local youths were known to hang out.
sentences.zh: 乔治的一个同伴告诉舒尔茨警官，附近海滩上有一个临时搭建的小屋，当地年轻人经常在那里聚会。

sentences.en: Schultz crossed the highway and headed towards the shore to check if the missing teens were there.
sentences.zh: 舒尔茨穿过公路，朝海岸走去，想看看失踪的年轻人在不在那里。

sentences.en: It took a few minutes to hike down the steep, bush-lined trail to the water's edge.
sentences.zh: 沿着布满灌木的陡峭小径下行到水边花了几分钟时间。

sentences.en: The secluded area attracted few visitors, aside from drifters who travelled along the nearby Southern Pacific Railroad.
sentences.zh: 这个偏僻的地区很少有人来，除了沿着附近南太平洋铁路出没的流浪汉。

sentences.en: One had built the shack out of driftwood, cardboard, tin and grass among the trees and vegetation a few yards back from the water.
sentences.zh: 其中一人用浮木、硬纸板、铁皮和青草在距离水面几十码远的树木和植被中搭建了这个小屋。

sentences.en: When Officer Schultz reached the crudely built shack, it was in bad shape.
sentences.zh: 当舒尔茨警官走到这个粗糙的小屋时，它已经面目全非。

sentences.en: Someone had tried to destroy it by pulling the roof down from within.
sentences.zh: 有人曾从内部拉垮屋顶试图将其毁掉。

sentences.en: Inside, partially concealed by the collapsed roof, was a horrific sight.
sentences.zh: 屋里是一个惨不忍睹的景象，被塌陷的屋顶半掩盖着。

sentences.en: The bloodied bodies of Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards were piled one on top of the other.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·多明格斯和琳达·爱德华兹血肉模糊的尸体叠压在一起。

sentences.en: 22 caliber long rifle bullets, lengths of pre-cut cord and burnt-out matches found throughout the crime scene, helped investigators piece together what likely happened.
sentences.zh: 现场发现的.22口径长步枪子弹、预先裁好的绳索以及烧尽的火柴，帮助调查人员拼凑出了可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: While Linda's bathing suit was cut open, there was no evidence that she had been sexually assaulted.
sentences.zh: 虽然琳达的泳衣被划开，但没有证据表明她曾遭受性侵。

sentences.en: Police were dealing with a particularly cunning offender, who had the foresight to stage the crime scene in an attempt to throw them off.
sentences.zh: 警方正面对一个极其狡猾的罪犯，他未雨绸缪地伪造了犯罪现场，企图以此误导警方。

sentences.en: It was clear the killer had hoped to cover up his crime by destroying the shack.
sentences.zh: 显然，凶手希望通过摧毁棚屋来掩盖他的罪行。

sentences.en: But, unluckily for him, the matches snuffed out before the fire took hold.
sentences.zh: 但对他来说不幸的是，火势蔓延之前火柴就熄灭了。

sentences.en: As both victims were popular and well-liked, it was hard to identify a motive for the killings.
sentences.zh: 由于两名受害者都很受欢迎且人缘很好，因此很难确定谋杀动机。

sentences.en: But not everyone was happy for the young couple.
sentences.zh: 但并不是每个人都为这对年轻夫妇感到高兴。

sentences.en: 17-year-old Jason, not his real name, was known to be openly jealous of Robert Dominguez.
sentences.zh: 17岁的杰森（化名）众所周知对罗伯特·多明格斯公开嫉妒。

sentences.en: Robert was a star player on the school's football team and was dating a cheerleader, whereas Jason was in and out of trouble with police.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特是学校橄榄球队的明星球员，并与一名啦啦队员在约会，而杰森则经常因惹麻烦而进出警察局。

sentences.en: He'd been arrested multiple times, including immediately after the murders, for causing trouble while intoxicated.
sentences.zh: 他曾多次被捕，包括谋杀发生后立即因酒后滋事而被捕。

sentences.en: On the day of the double homicide, Jason was at a beach four miles from the one Robert and Linda were visiting.
sentences.zh: 在这起双重谋杀案发生的当天，杰森在距离罗伯特和琳达游玩的海滩四英里外的一个海滩上。

sentences.en: During questioning, police noticed that Jason's hand was bruised, as though he'd been in a fight.
sentences.zh: 在审讯期间，警察注意到杰森的手有瘀伤，就像刚打过架一样。

sentences.en: He also admitted to having access to his father's guns.
sentences.zh: 他还承认自己能够接触到他父亲的枪支。

sentences.en: Still, there was nothing directly linking Jason to the murders, and he was released without charge.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，没有直接证据将杰森与谋杀案联系起来，他被无罪释放。

sentences.en: After speaking with locals, railroad men, and youths that frequented the beach area, investigators became aware of a 50-year-old army veteran turned drifter named George Gill.
sentences.zh: 在与当地人、铁路工人和经常去海滩地区的年轻人交谈后，调查人员注意到了一位名叫乔治·吉尔的50岁退伍军人兼流浪汉。

sentences.en: A loner with a penchant for military-style clothing, Gill visited the Gaviota Beach often, surviving on the pelicans, mussels, and wild mustard he found there.
sentences.zh: 吉尔是一个独来独往的人，喜好军事风格的服装，经常光顾加维奥塔海滩，靠他在那里找到的鹈鹕、贻贝和野芥菜维生。

sentences.en: Gill had actually built the shack where Robert and Linda's bodies were found, and was reportedly living in it in the days prior to the murders.
sentences.zh: 吉尔实际上建造了发现罗伯特和琳达尸体的棚屋，据报道在谋杀发生前的几天里他就住在里面。

sentences.en: He kept a .22 calibre rifle in a bundle strapped to his back, which he was seen firing in the area.
sentences.zh: 他把一支.22口径步枪装在一个绑在背上的背包里，曾有人看到他在该地区开枪。

sentences.en: Could Gill have been responsible for the gunshots heard and even felt by the two groups of teenagers
sentences.zh: 吉尔会是两组青少年听到甚至感受到枪声的罪魁祸首吗？

sentences.en: near Tahegas Creek and Gaviota State Park in the days before Robert and Linda were killed?
sentences.zh: 在罗伯特和琳达被杀前几天，他们在塔赫加斯溪和加维奥塔州立公园附近听到枪声？

sentences.en: The teens had described the gunfire as having come from a .22 calibre semi-automatic firearm, possibly a long rifle.
sentences.zh: 青少年们形容枪声来自一把.22口径半自动枪械，可能是一支长步枪。

sentences.en: There was no way to know for sure.
sentences.zh: 没有办法确定。

sentences.en: By the time Gill was brought to police attention, he was long gone.
sentences.zh: 等到吉尔引起警方注意时，他早已逃之夭夭。

sentences.en: The bullets recovered from Robert and Linda's bodies were too versatile to isolate exactly what type of firearm they came from.
sentences.zh: 从罗伯特和琳达尸体中取出的子弹用途太广，无法准确隔离它们来自哪种枪械。

sentences.en: But the discovery of several boxes of Winchester Western Super X long rifle ammunition inside the beach shack helped direct detectives to the bullets' origin.
sentences.zh: 但在海滩棚屋里发现的几盒温彻斯特西方超级X长步枪弹药帮助侦探锁定了子弹的来源。

sentences.en: The boxes, one empty and three partially filled, featured a lot number, TL-21.
sentences.zh: 这些盒子，一个空的和三个半满的，标有批号TL-21。

sentences.en: While this batch was stocked in local sports stores, it was also sold at a base exchange at the
sentences.zh: 虽然这批货物在当地的体育用品商店有售，但也在

sentences.en: Vandenberg Air Force Base, just over nine miles from Lompoc.
sentences.zh: 范登堡空军基地的基地交易所出售，距离隆波克仅九英里多。

sentences.en: Yet, the boxes lacked any identifiers that could help narrow down where or when they were purchased.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些盒子没有任何可以帮助缩小购买地点或时间的标识。

sentences.en: As these bullets were also the most popular and common type of ammunition purchased, it was difficult to isolate a suspect using this evidence alone.
sentences.zh: 由于这些子弹也是购买最多、最常见的弹药类型，仅凭此证据很难孤立出嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The graduation ceremony for Lompoc High's senior class of 1963 was held on Thursday June 6, the day after Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards were found murdered.
sentences.zh: 隆波克高中1963届毕业典礼于6月6日星期四举行，也就是罗伯特·多明格斯和琳达·爱德华兹被发现遇害的第二天。

sentences.en: The mood amongst the students was sombre and they laid wreaths on two empty seats in honour of their slain classmates.
sentences.zh: 学生们的情绪十分凝重，他们在两个空座位上献上花圈，以纪念他们遇害的同班同学。

sentences.en: That same day, two teens were transferred to Santa Barbara County Sheriff's Department, having just confessed to witnessing a murder.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，两名青少年被移交给圣巴巴拉县治安官办公室，他们刚刚承认目睹了一起谋杀案。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案卷档案稍后将继续播出。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持案卷档案继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: 16-year-old James Coleman and his friend, 17-year-old J.C.
sentences.zh: 16岁的詹姆斯·科尔曼和他的朋友、17岁的J.C.

sentences.en: Reid Jr., eyed the stranger before them.
sentences.zh: 里德小杰夫，打量着他们面前的陌生人。

sentences.en: He was maybe a year or two older than them, of average height and build, with thick natural blonde hair combed to one side.
sentences.zh: 他可能比他们大一两岁，中等身高和体型，浓密的天然金发梳向一侧。

sentences.en: A pair of black-rimmed prescription eyeglasses framed his pale blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 一副黑框处方眼镜框住了他苍白的蓝眼睛。

sentences.en: In between taking drags from a pow-mow cigarette he held at the base of his fingers, the stranger introduced himself as Sandy and said he'd run away from his home in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 陌生人一边用手指根部夹着抽一口无过滤嘴香烟，一边介绍自己叫桑迪，并说他是从旧金山的家中逃出来的。

sentences.en: Sandy's story was inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 桑迪的说法前后矛盾。

sentences.en: Each time he told it, the details varied slightly.
sentences.zh: 每次他讲述时，细节都会略有不同。

sentences.en: Whatever the truth, Sandy was a transient who'd taken to sleeping under the Santa Cruz boardwalk.
sentences.zh: 不管真相如何，桑迪是一个开始睡在圣克鲁斯海滨步道下的流浪汉。

sentences.en: His peculiarities soon made him a recognisable figure to locals, who thought his army fatigues were an odd choice of attire for someone living on the beach.
sentences.zh: 他特立独行，很快成为当地人的熟面孔，当地人认为他的迷彩服对于一个住在海滩上的人来说是一个奇怪的选择。

sentences.en: Sandy often asked other young men where he could find girls, even though girls clearly weren't interested in him.
sentences.zh: 桑迪经常问其他年轻人在哪里可以找到女孩，尽管女孩们显然对他不感兴趣。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Sandy received a warning from police after a young woman complained that he'd been bothering her.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一名年轻女性抱怨桑迪一直纠缠她后，桑迪受到了警察的警告。

sentences.en: While Sandy's requests for food or drinks from passersby weren't particularly unusual, he raised eyebrows when he produced a knife and asked where he could get it sharpened.
sentences.zh: 虽然桑迪向路人索要食物或饮料并不特别寻常，但当他掏出一把刀并询问在哪里可以磨尖它时，他引起了人们的注意。

sentences.en: There was no doubt that Sandy was a strange character, but James Coleman and J.C.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，桑迪是个奇怪的角色，但詹姆斯·科尔曼和J.C.

sentences.en: Reid Jr.
sentences.zh: 里德小杰夫

sentences.en: were somewhat charmed by him.
sentences.zh: 对他有点着迷。

sentences.en: On the day they met, the trio teamed up and embarked on a crime spree that led them 200 miles south to Lompoc.
sentences.zh: 在他们相遇的那天，三人组队并开始了一场犯罪狂潮，将他们带到了200英里以南的隆波克。

sentences.en: Coleman and Reid weren't new to petty crime, but Sandy's influence seemingly emboldened them to commit increasingly violent acts.
sentences.zh: 科尔曼和里德对轻微犯罪并不陌生，但桑迪的影响似乎助长了他们实施日益暴力的行为。

sentences.en: During their misadventures, Coleman and Reid gifted Sandy a pair of black pants and a black slip-over shirt with a button-down collar.
sentences.zh: 在他们的冒险经历中，科尔曼和里德赠送给桑迪一条黑裤子和一件带有纽扣领的黑色套头衬衫。

sentences.en: They also supplied him with a yellow-handled fishing knife, though Sandy desired a deadlier weapon.
sentences.zh: 他们还为他提供了一把黄柄钓鱼刀，尽管桑迪渴望更致命的武器。

sentences.en: He kept talking about wanting to procure a .22-caliber rifle.
sentences.zh: 他一直谈论想要获得一把.22口径步枪。

sentences.en: In Lompoc later that night, they approached 63-year-old quarry worker Vernon Smith with the intention of robbing him.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候在隆波克，他们接近了63岁的采石场工人弗农·史密斯，企图抢劫他。

sentences.en: Sandy asked for Vernon's help, explaining that they'd run out of gas.
sentences.zh: 桑迪请求弗农的帮助，解释说他们的汽油用完了。

sentences.en: As Vernon used a gas can to fill the tank of the stolen sunbeam,
sentences.zh: 当弗农用油桶给被盗的太阳光汽车油箱加油时，

sentences.en: Sandy walked up behind him and pulled out his fishing knife.
sentences.zh: 桑迪走到他身后，拔出了他的钓鱼刀。

sentences.en: This wasn't part of the plan.
sentences.zh: 这不在计划之内。

sentences.en: Coleman yelled at Sandy.
sentences.zh: 科尔曼对桑迪大喊。

sentences.en: Don't do it, boy.
sentences.zh: 别这么做，孩子。

sentences.en: Sandy ignored him and plunged the knife into Vernon's back, killing him.
sentences.zh: 桑迪不理他，把刀刺进弗农的背部，杀死了他。

sentences.en: Stunned by the sudden and brutal attack, Coleman asked Sandy why he did it.
sentences.zh: 科尔曼被这突如其来的残酷袭击惊呆了，问桑迪为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: Sandy shrugged and, with cool indifference, said he didn't know.
sentences.zh: 桑迪耸耸肩，冷漠地回答说他不知道。

sentences.en: He then laughed, as if the whole thing was a joke.
sentences.zh: 然后他笑了，好像整件事是个笑话。

sentences.en: The murder marked the end of Sandy's time with Coleman and Reid.
sentences.zh: 这起谋杀标志着桑迪与科尔曼和里德在一起的时间结束了。

sentences.en: Unnerved, the boys ditched Sandy at a motel in Arroyo Grande, 45 miles north of Lompoc.
sentences.zh: 惊慌失措的男孩们把桑迪抛弃在隆波克以北45英里阿罗约格兰德的一家汽车旅馆里。

sentences.en: The very next day, Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards were shot dead on Gaviota Beach.
sentences.zh: 就在第二天，罗伯特·多明格斯和琳达·爱德华兹在加维奥塔海滩被枪杀。

sentences.en: Police caught up with James Coleman and J.C.
sentences.zh: 警察找到了詹姆斯·科尔曼和J.C.

sentences.en: Reid Jr.
sentences.zh: 里德小杰夫

sentences.en: and arrested them in relation to one of the robberies they committed during their crime spree.
sentences.zh: 并因他们犯罪狂潮期间实施的一起抢劫案而逮捕了他们。

sentences.en: When grilled about Vernon Smith's murder, the pair quickly implicated Sandy, but neither could provide his full name.
sentences.zh: 当被盘问关于弗农·史密斯的谋杀案时，两人很快供出了桑迪，但谁也无法提供他的全名。

sentences.en: They weren't even certain if he was really named Sandy.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不确定他是否真的叫桑迪。

sentences.en: While police were wary of Coleman and Reid's story, it appeared to be the truth.
sentences.zh: 虽然警察对科尔曼和里德的说法持谨慎态度，但这似乎是事实。

sentences.en: Other people confirmed Sandy's existence and he had been sided with Coleman and Reid in Lompoc.
sentences.zh: 其他人证实了桑迪的存在，他曾在隆波克与科尔曼和里德在一起。

sentences.en: One witness recalled him carrying a yellow-handled fishing knife, exactly like the one Coleman and Reid said he used to kill Vernon Smith.
sentences.zh: 一名目击者回忆说他带着一把黄柄钓鱼刀，和科尔曼和里德说他用来杀死弗农·史密斯的刀一模一样。

sentences.en: There had been no sightings of Sandy since Coleman and Reid abandoned him at the motel in Arroyo Grande, but police were able to piece together his possible movements.
sentences.zh: 自从科尔曼和里德在阿罗约格兰德的汽车旅馆抛弃桑迪以来，就再也没有人见过他，但警察能够拼凑出他可能的动向。

sentences.en: After killing Vernon Smith, Sandy had pocketed $20.
sentences.zh: 杀死弗农·史密斯后，桑迪把20美元放进了口袋。

sentences.en: It was believed that he used some of this money to fund an overnight stay at the motel.
sentences.zh: 据信他用这些钱的一部分资助了在汽车旅馆过夜。

sentences.en: He booked a room using the pseudonym William Carr and a fake address.
sentences.zh: 他用化名威廉·卡尔和一个假地址预订了一个房间。

sentences.en: Before checking out at 11 the following morning, a seasoned hitchhiker, Sandy would have been capable of securing a ride further south.
sentences.zh: 在第二天上午11点退房之前，作为一个经验丰富的搭便车者，桑迪本有能力找到一辆车去更南方。

sentences.en: He could have obtained a gun and ammunition at any point throughout his journey.
sentences.zh: 他可能在旅途中的任何时候获得枪支和弹药。

sentences.en: Known for approaching locals and begging for help, someone might have told him he could stay at the beach shack near Gabbiota State Park.
sentences.zh: 以接近当地人并乞求帮助而闻名，可能有人告诉他可以住在加维奥塔州立公园附近的海滩棚屋里。

sentences.en: No stranger to sleeping rough, Sandy would have been comfortable holed up there for a night.
sentences.zh: 对于习惯露宿的人来说，桑迪会在那里舒舒服服地躲上一晚。

sentences.en: He might have spotted Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards arriving the next day.
sentences.zh: 他可能发现罗伯特·多明格斯和琳达·爱德华兹第二天到达。

sentences.en: Sandy was carrying at least one knife which he could have used to cut the rope ligatures as well as Linda's bathing suit.
sentences.zh: 桑迪随身携带至少一把刀，他可以用来割断绳索以及琳达的泳衣。

sentences.en: Given he was a smoker, it was likely he would have been carrying a pack of matches.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他是个烟民，他很可能随身携带一包火柴。

sentences.en: This timeline, coupled with Sandy's willingness to kill and desire to obtain a .22 calibre firearm, put him high on the list of suspects in the double homicide.
sentences.zh: 这个时间线，加上桑迪杀人的意愿和获得.22口径枪械的渴望，使他成为这起双重谋杀案的高嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The hunt for Sandy was on.
sentences.zh: 对桑迪的搜捕开始了。

sentences.en: A composite sketch was created based on descriptions from those who had interacted with him.
sentences.zh: 根据与他有过接触的人的描述，制作了一张综合素描。

sentences.en: Police dubbed him the Laughing Boy and the Laughing Killer due to his amused demeanour following the stabbing of Vernon Smith.
sentences.zh: 由于他在刺伤弗农·史密斯后表现出 amused 的神情，警察称他为笑面男孩和笑面杀手。

sentences.en: Alleged sightings of Sandy were reported across the state.
sentences.zh: 据报道，全州都有人目击了桑迪。

sentences.en: Sacramento teen Robert Lee Bell was one such lookalike.
sentences.zh: 萨克拉门托青少年罗伯特·李·贝尔就是这样一个长相相似的人。

sentences.en: The 17-year-old raised eyebrows when he abruptly quit his job at a Lompoc car wash and skipped town days before the Dominguez Edwards murders.
sentences.zh: 这名17岁的少年在多明格斯-爱德华兹谋杀案发生前几天突然辞去隆波克洗车场的工作并逃离该镇，引起了人们的注意。

sentences.en: Before he left, he stole a .22 calibre rifle and ammunition.
sentences.zh: 在他离开之前，他偷了一把.22口径步枪和弹药。

sentences.en: When police tracked Bell down, he still had the gun in his possession.
sentences.zh: 当警察追踪到贝尔时，他身上仍然藏有这把枪。

sentences.en: Weak old scratches marked his wrists and forearms, but Bell insisted they'd been caused by a puppy.
sentences.zh: 虚弱的旧划痕标志着他的手腕和前臂，但贝尔坚称它们是小狗造成的。

sentences.en: Ballistics confirmed that Bell's rifle wasn't the murder weapon, and when several witnesses placed him at a Sacramento baseball game on the day of the shooting,
sentences.zh: 弹道学证实贝尔的步枪不是谋杀武器，当几名目击者将他安排在枪击案当天在萨克拉门托棒球场时，

sentences.en: he was dropped as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 他被取消了嫌疑人身份。

sentences.en: Bell was just one of several young men suspected of being Sandy.
sentences.zh: 贝尔只是被怀疑是桑迪的几名年轻男子之一。

sentences.en: While some owned or had access to .22 calibre firearms, investigators couldn't connect any of these weapons to the crime.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些人拥有或可以使用.22口径枪械，但调查人员无法将这些武器中的任何一个与犯罪联系起来。

sentences.en: Clues were scarce, and those police did have were confusing.
sentences.zh: 线索很少，警察掌握的那些线索也令人困惑。

sentences.en: Sandy had left behind a green military jacket which had the name Robert Kaufman scrawled along the inside of the collar.
sentences.zh: 桑迪留下了一件绿色军装夹克，领子内侧潦草地写着罗伯特·考夫曼的名字。

sentences.en: Coleman and Reed recalled Sandy saying he had stolen the jacket and the rest of his army clothes.
sentences.zh: 科尔曼和里德回忆说桑迪说他偷了这件夹克和他的其他军装。

sentences.en: It was also possible that Kaufman was just another of Sandy's aliases.
sentences.zh: 也有可能考夫曼只是桑迪的另一个化名。

sentences.en: Either way, the name was a dead end.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种方式，这个名字都是死胡同。

sentences.en: For their involvement in the killing of Vernon Smith,
sentences.zh: 由于他们参与谋杀弗农·史密斯，

sentences.en: James Coleman and J.C.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·科尔曼和J.C.

sentences.en: Reed Jr.
sentences.zh: 里德小杰夫

sentences.en: pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit robbery and second-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 对串谋实施抢劫和二级谋杀的罪名认罪。

sentences.en: They were sent to prison, while the person they alleged had committed the slaying remained on the run.
sentences.zh: 他们被送进监狱，而他们指控实施谋杀的人仍然在逃。

sentences.en: The evening of Wednesday, February 5, 1964.
sentences.zh: 1964年2月5日星期三晚上。

sentences.en: Eight months after the murders of Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·多明格斯和琳达·爱德华兹遇害八个月后。

sentences.en: In Ocean Beach, California.
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州海洋海滩。

sentences.en: Although Johnny and Joyce Swindle had only been staying in Ocean Beach for a week, they'd already formed a nightly routine.
sentences.zh: 尽管强尼和乔伊斯·斯温德尔在海洋海滩只呆了一个星期，但他们已经形成了每晚的惯例。

sentences.en: The newlyweds, aged 20 and 19 respectively, did everything together, from washing the dishes to making their bed.
sentences.zh: 这对新婚夫妇分别20岁和19岁，做什么都在一起，从洗碗到铺床。

sentences.en: Every evening, they left their rented bungalow to take a stroll down to the beach.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，他们都会离开租来的平房，去海滩散步。

sentences.en: The night of February 5 was no different, except for a brief visit to a pharmacy where Johnny purchased a red heart-shaped box of candy for his wife.
sentences.zh: 2月5日的夜晚没有什么不同，除了去药房进行了一次简短的访问，强尼为他的妻子买了一盒红色的心形糖果。

sentences.en: Valentine's Day was more than a week away, but it didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 情人节还有一周多，但这没关系。

sentences.en: The childhood sweethearts had been on cloud nine since their wedding three weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 这对青梅竹马自三周前结婚以来一直处于云端。

sentences.en: The couple continued their usual walk, which ended nine blocks from their home, at the beachfront.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇继续他们通常的散步，在距离他们家九个街区的海滨结束。

sentences.en: Joyce in particular loved the ocean.
sentences.zh: 乔伊斯尤其热爱大海。

sentences.en: It fascinated her, and Johnny couldn't keep her away.
sentences.zh: 它令她着迷，强尼无法阻止她。

sentences.en: During the day, Ocean Beach Foreshore was a hive of activity.
sentences.zh: 白天，海洋海滩前滨是一个充满活力的活动场所。

sentences.en: Tourists and fishermen lined its pier as swimmers took to the surf below.
sentences.zh: 游客和渔民排在码头上，游泳者则在下面的冲浪区冲浪。

sentences.en: Just left of the pier, at the foot of Narragansett Avenue, was a wide concrete patio that provided uninterrupted views of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 就在码头左侧，纳拉甘西特大道的尽头，是一个宽阔的混凝土露台，可以一览无余地欣赏大海。

sentences.en: It was the perfect spot to observe the sunset.
sentences.zh: 这是观赏日落的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: By late evening, most beachgoers had retreated like the tide, leaving the area peaceful and private.
sentences.zh: 到了深夜，大多数海滩游客像潮水一样退去，使该地区变得和平而私密。

sentences.en: Placing the candy box on the retaining wall framing the water,
sentences.zh: 将糖果盒放在构成水景的挡土墙上，

sentences.en: Johnny and Joyce snuggled together, oblivious to anyone but each other.
sentences.zh: 强尼和乔伊斯依偎在一起，除了彼此对外面的世界一无所知。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, Johnny was struck in the back by something small but powerful.
sentences.zh: 突然，强尼的背部被某种小而强力的东西击中。

sentences.en: He barely had time to register the accompanying pain before Joyce collapsed into his arMs.
sentences.zh: 他还没来得及意识到随之而来的痛苦，乔伊斯就倒在了他的怀里。

sentences.en: She too had been hit in the upper back.
sentences.zh: 她也被击中了上背部。

sentences.en: Quickly realising that they were being shot at,
sentences.zh: 很快意识到他们正在遭受枪击，

sentences.en: Johnny turned his body into the line of fire trying to shield his wife from the barrage.
sentences.zh: 强尼将身体转向火力线，试图保护他的妻子免受弹幕袭击。

sentences.en: His pained cries of no, no, carried up the cliffside to the apartment buildings above.
sentences.zh: 他痛苦的“不，不”的喊声传到了悬崖上方的公寓楼。

sentences.en: Johnny's left thigh was hit and another bullet struck the right side of his head.
sentences.zh: 强尼的左大腿被击中，另一颗子弹击中了头部右侧。

sentences.en: A bullet pierced Joyce's left arm.
sentences.zh: 一颗子弹穿透了乔伊斯的左臂。

sentences.en: Exposed and unable to see their assailant in the dark, the couple crumpled helplessly to the ground.
sentences.zh: 暴露在外且在黑暗中看不到袭击者，这对夫妇无助地瘫倒在地上。

sentences.en: With his victims immobilised, the shooter eased down the rocky cliff face to the patio below.
sentences.zh: 在受害者失去行动能力后，枪手顺着岩石悬崖面走到下面的露台上。

sentences.en: Joyce was face down when he marched up and shot her at point-blank range in the back of the head.
sentences.zh: 当他走过去近距离朝她的后脑勺开枪时，乔伊斯正脸朝下。

sentences.en: Then he turned towards Johnny, who had collapsed against the retaining wall, and fired a bullet into his left ear.
sentences.zh: 然后他转向靠在挡土墙上的强尼，朝他的左耳开了一枪。

sentences.en: After rummaging through Johnny's pockets and taking whatever he could find, the killer then fled the scene.
sentences.zh: 翻找了强尼的口袋并拿走他能找到的一切后，凶手逃离了现场。

sentences.en: A short while later, Ocean Beach local Edward Nelson descended the steps that led to the patio overlooking the sea.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，海洋海滩当地人爱德华·纳尔逊走下通往俯瞰大海的露台的台阶。

sentences.en: Spotting something on the ground ahead,
sentences.zh: 发现前面地上有什么东西，

sentences.en: Edward raised his flashlight, illuminating two bodies piled on top of one another.
sentences.zh: 爱德华举起手电筒，照亮了叠在一起的两具尸体。

sentences.en: Edward suspected he had stumbled across a pair of drunk lovers who had passed out together.
sentences.zh: 爱德华怀疑他偶然发现了一对醉酒倒在一起的情侣。

sentences.en: Edging closer, his flashlight reflected off something glistening and red.
sentences.zh: 走近一点，他的手电筒反射出某种闪闪发光的红色。

sentences.en: Underneath the couple was a large pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇下面是一大滩血。

sentences.en: Two empty .22 calibre long rifle cartridges lay nearby.
sentences.zh: 两枚空.22口径长步枪弹壳躺在附近。

sentences.en: Matching shells were also found on a dark, well-hidden clifftop 50 feet above.
sentences.zh: 在上方50英尺处一个黑暗且隐蔽的悬崖顶部，也发现了相匹配的弹壳。

sentences.en: By the time Edward found the swindles, it was too late for Joyce.
sentences.zh: 等爱德华发现斯温德尔夫妇时，对乔伊斯来说已经太晚了。

sentences.en: However, Johnny was clinging to life.
sentences.zh: 然而，约翰尼还在顽强地挣扎求生。

sentences.en: Gurgling and gasping for air, he managed to weakly lift himself up and drape one arm over his wife's body.
sentences.zh: 他大口喘着粗气，喉咙里发出咕噜声，勉强撑起身体，把一只胳膊搭在妻子的尸体上。

sentences.en: Witnesses heard him splutter.
sentences.zh: 目击者听到他发出含糊不清的喘息声。

sentences.en: My God, how much blood does a person have?
sentences.zh: 我的天哪，一个人身上怎么会有这么多血？

sentences.en: He lost consciousness and was taken to hospital, where he died less than three hours later.
sentences.zh: 他失去了意识并被送往医院，不到三小时后便在那里去世了。

sentences.en: While no one saw the shooting take place, an unidentified man was spotted standing on the rocks near the patio shortly before the swindles arrived.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有人目睹枪击过程，但在斯温德尔夫妇到达之前不久，曾有人看到一个身份不明的男子站在露台附近的岩石上。

sentences.en: Fifteen minutes later, another witness saw a man running at full speed along Del Monte Avenue, away from the beachfront.
sentences.zh: 十五分钟后，另一名目击者看到一名男子正沿着德尔蒙特大道全速奔跑，远离海滨。

sentences.en: It couldn't be ascertained exactly what type of firearm was used in the crime.
sentences.zh: 目前无法确定案中究竟使用了哪种类型的枪械。

sentences.en: A sniper rifle correlated with the crime scene's layout and the position of the shooter.
sentences.zh: 一把狙击步枪与犯罪现场的布局及枪手的位置相吻合。

sentences.en: However, the erratic gunfire and execution-style headshots were more in line with someone wielding a handgun.
sentences.zh: 然而，毫无章法的枪击和行刑式的爆头则更符合手枪持有者的特征。

sentences.en: Although Johnny's wallet had been stolen, robbery didn't appear to have been the killer's true motive.
sentences.zh: 虽然约翰尼的钱包被偷了，但抢劫似乎并非凶手的真正动机。

sentences.en: Johnny was so short on cash that he'd started painting for his landlord in lieu of paying rent, making it unlikely that he had much money on him.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼手头紧到开始帮房东刷墙来抵租，这使得他身上不太可能有很多钱。

sentences.en: Robbery might have been the killer's secondary motive, or merely an afterthought intended to confuse investigators.
sentences.zh: 抢劫可能是凶手的次要动机，或者仅仅是为了迷惑调查人员而临时起意。

sentences.en: There was little in the victims' lives that indicated the crime was personal.
sentences.zh: 受害者的生平中几乎没有什么迹象表明这是一起谋杀私仇。

sentences.en: Johnny and Joyce had barely settled into their apartment, where they kept to themselves.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼和乔伊斯刚搬进公寓，平时深居简出。

sentences.en: They were making the most of their honeymoon period before Johnny reported for naval duty aboard a radar picket ship.
sentences.zh: 在约翰尼登上一艘雷达警戒舰履行海军职责之前，他们正尽情享受着蜜月期。

sentences.en: Nothing in their backgrounds pointed to someone they knew wanting to kill them.
sentences.zh: 他们的背景中没有任何迹象表明他们认识的人想要杀害他们。

sentences.en: Police concluded that the crime was a senseless thrill killing, committed by a psychopathic killer, whose only motive was excitement.
sentences.zh: 警方得出结论，这起案件是一起毫无意义的快感杀人案，由一名精神病杀手所为，其唯一的动机就是寻求刺激。

sentences.en: With the murders of Johnny and Joyce Swindle, a pattern was beginning to emerge.
sentences.zh: 随着约翰尼和乔伊斯·斯温德尔遇害，一种犯罪模式开始显现。

sentences.en: The similarities between the Swindle's killing and that of Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards less than a year prior was not lost on investigators.
sentences.zh: 调查人员并没有忽视斯温德尔夫妇的遇害与不到一年前罗伯特·多明格斯和琳达·爱德华兹遇害案之间的相似之处。

sentences.en: A young couple, a .22 calibre firearm, long rifle ammunition, a waterside crime scene, lack of motive or suspects, the randomness of the attack.
sentences.zh: 一对年轻夫妇、一把.22口径枪械、长步枪弹药、水边犯罪现场、缺乏动机或嫌疑人、袭击的随机性。

sentences.en: Although ballistics confirmed that a different gun was used in each crime, a lingering suspicion remained that one person was responsible for both.
sentences.zh: 尽管弹道学证实每起案件中使用的枪支不同，但人们依然挥之不去一种怀疑，即两起案件由同一人所为。

sentences.en: Three days after the murders of Johnny and Joyce Swindle, a priest sat in the confessional of St. Joseph's Catholic Church in San Diego.
sentences.zh: 在约翰尼和乔伊斯·斯温德尔遇害三天后，一名神父坐在圣迭戈圣约瑟夫天主教堂的告解室里。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before he heard a footfall echoing off the terracotta tiles as someone made their way down the centre aisle.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他就听到一阵脚步声在红土瓷砖上回响，有人正顺着中央过道走来。

sentences.en: The footsteps stopped at the confessional.
sentences.zh: 脚步声在告解室停了下来。

sentences.en: A man took a seat inside, cleared his throat, and said,
sentences.zh: 一名男子在里面坐下，清了清嗓子，说道：

sentences.en: Bless me, Father, for I have sinned.
sentences.zh: 请神父宽恕我，我犯了罪。

sentences.en: I have an urge to hurt someone.
sentences.zh: 我有伤害别人的冲动。

sentences.en: Anyone.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以。

sentences.en: The priest paused, uncertain of what to say.
sentences.zh: 神父停顿了一下，不确定该说些什么。

sentences.en: Before he could respond, the man leapt from his seat and ran from the church.
sentences.zh: 还没等他回应，那名男子就从座位上跳起来跑出了教堂。

sentences.en: The confessor was identified as 18-year-old René Leon Trudeau.
sentences.zh: 经确认，告解者是18岁的勒内·莱昂·特鲁多。

sentences.en: A transient who worked part-time as a janitor,
sentences.zh: 一个兼职做看门人的流浪汉，

sentences.en: René was arrested and booked at the city jail on suspicion of murdering the Swindles.
sentences.zh: 勒内因涉嫌谋杀斯温德尔夫妇被捕并关押在市监狱。

sentences.en: He told the arresting officer, I would hurt you if I had the chance, any way I could.
sentences.zh: 他对抓捕他的警官说：“如果有机会，我会伤害你，用我能做到的任何方式。”

sentences.en: That's why I saw the prieSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我来找神父的原因。

sentences.en: I guess I need help.
sentences.zh: 我想我需要帮助。

sentences.en: With no evidence to tie him to the double homicide,
sentences.zh: 由于没有证据将他与这起双重谋杀案联系起来，

sentences.en: René was released without charge.
sentences.zh: 勒内被无罪释放。

sentences.en: Across the Pacific Ocean in Hawaii, television repairman Michael Patrick Moller purchased a gun on a whim.
sentences.zh: 在太平洋对岸的夏威夷，电视修理工迈克尔·帕特里克·莫勒一时兴起买了一把枪。

sentences.en: The 23-year-old made his way up the steep mountainside five miles outside of Honolulu to the Pali Lookout.
sentences.zh: 这名23岁的年轻人沿着檀香山郊外五英里处陡峭的山坡向上走去，来到了帕利观景台。

sentences.en: The mountain provided stunning panoramic views across the island of Oahu, but Moller wasn't there to enjoy the scenery.
sentences.zh: 这座山提供了俯瞰瓦胡岛全岛的绝佳全景视野，但莫勒来这里可不是为了欣赏风景。

sentences.en: Instead, he crouched amongst the dense vegetation and raised his firearm.
sentences.zh: 相反，他蹲在茂密的植被中，举起了手中的枪。

sentences.en: He watched as a tourist bus descended on the area.
sentences.zh: 他看着一辆旅游大巴驶入该地区。

sentences.en: With his sights set on the vehicle, he pulled the trigger.
sentences.zh: 他的准星锁定目标车辆，扣动了扳机。

sentences.en: His shooting spree continued for five hours.
sentences.zh: 他的疯狂枪击持续了五个小时。

sentences.en: By the end, four people were injured and a highway patrolman had lost his life.
sentences.zh: 最终，四人受伤，一名高速公路巡警不幸殉职。

sentences.en: Moller blamed the attack on his mental health.
sentences.zh: 莫勒将这次袭击归咎于自己的心理健康问题。

sentences.en: It wasn't the first time something like this had happened.
sentences.zh: 这并不是第一次发生这种事。

sentences.en: He'd previously committed another sniping in Germany while serving in the US Air Force.
sentences.zh: 他此前在美国空军服役期间，曾在德国实施过另一次狙击。

sentences.en: Investigators fronting the swindle case arrived in Hawaii and entered the state hospital ward.
sentences.zh: 负责斯温德尔案的调查人员抵达夏威夷并进入了州立医院病房。

sentences.en: They made their way to the psychiatric ward where Michael Patrick Moller was being held.
sentences.zh: 他们径直走向关押迈克尔·帕特里克·莫勒的精神科病房。

sentences.en: With his military ties and known love of guns, police considered whether Moller could also be responsible for the Swindles murder or that of Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他有军方背景且众所周知热爱枪支，警方怀疑莫勒是否也应对斯温德尔夫妇或罗伯特·多明格斯与琳达·爱德华兹的谋杀案负责。

sentences.en: Moller told police that at the time the newlyweds were killed, he was undergoing psychiatric care in Texas in response to the German shooting.
sentences.zh: 莫勒告诉警方，在新婚夫妇遇害时，他正在德克萨斯州接受针对德国枪击事件的精神心理治疗。

sentences.en: His alibi checked out.
sentences.zh: 他的不在场证明经查属实。

sentences.en: Moller was cleared.
sentences.zh: 莫勒洗脱了嫌疑。

sentences.en: It was approaching midnight on December 1, 1964 when Santa Ana City Patrolman James Pico pulled up at a ramshackle campsite near the Santa Fe Railroad tracks.
sentences.zh: 1964年12月1日午夜临近时，圣安娜市巡警詹姆斯·皮科将车停在了圣达菲铁路线附近一个简陋的营地旁。

sentences.en: A woman had called police to report some property damage and she suspected a person at the camp was responsible.
sentences.zh: 一名女子打电话报警称发生了一些财产损失，她怀疑是营地里的某个人干的。

sentences.en: Pico had arrived to do a routine check of the site which consisted of makeshift shelters used by itinerants and the homeless.
sentences.zh: 皮科抵达现场对该营地进行例行检查，这里由流浪者和无家可归者搭建的临时避难所组成。

sentences.en: One person in particular caught the officer's attention.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个人格外引起了警官的注意。

sentences.en: A tall and thin reclusive man in his fifties with blue eyes, receding brown hair and a sullow, weather-beaten face.
sentences.zh: 一个五十多岁、身材高瘦且孤僻的男子，有着蓝色眼睛、向后退缩的棕色头发以及一张蜡黄、饱经风霜的脸。

sentences.en: Pico obtained the man's name and ran a background check.
sentences.zh: 皮科获取了该男子的姓名并对其进行了背景调查。

sentences.en: It turned out he was wanted for questioning in relation to the murders of Robert Dominguez and Linda Edwards.
sentences.zh: 结果发现他是罗伯特·多明格斯和琳达·爱德华兹谋杀案的通缉涉案人员。

sentences.en: Pico had inadvertently found George Gill, the drifter who had built the beach shack where the teenagers' bodies were discovered.
sentences.zh: 皮科无意中找到了乔治·吉尔——那个流浪汉，他曾建造了发现青少年尸体的海滩棚屋。

sentences.en: Gill had been on quite a journey in the year and a half he'd been avoiding police, funding part of his near 200-mile trip south by selling pistols he had stolen
sentences.zh: 在躲避警察的一年半时间里，吉尔经历了一段漫长的旅程，他通过出售从圣迭戈一处静修所偷来的手枪，

sentences.en: from a retreat in San Diego.
sentences.zh: 来资助他近200英里南下旅程的一部分开销。

sentences.en: He also sold a knife for bus fare.
sentences.zh: 他还卖掉了一把刀来凑车费。

sentences.en: Witnesses claimed that Gill was living out of the shack when the murders took place, but Gill insisted he'd left before then.
sentences.zh: 目击者称谋杀发生时吉尔就住在棚屋里，但吉尔坚称他在那之前就已经离开了。

sentences.en: He agreed to take a polygraph test, but an inconclusive result only propelled Gill into further suspicion.
sentences.zh: 他同意接受测谎仪测试，但 inconclusive（不确定）的结果反而让吉尔陷入了更深的怀疑中。

sentences.en: Yet, his alibi placing him in San Jose for work checked out, and George Gill, like many others, was scrubbed from the suspect liSt.
sentences.zh: 然而，他当时在圣何塞工作的出示不在场证明的记录经查属实，于是乔治·吉尔和许多其他人一样，被从嫌疑人名单中划掉了。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, September 28, 1966, two and a half years after the swindles were gunned down, three residents of a San Diego apartment complex noticed something strange.
sentences.zh: 1966年9月28日，星期三，在斯温德尔夫妇遭枪杀两年半后，圣迭戈某公寓大楼的三位居民注意到了一些奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: There was a young man loitering outside the building.
sentences.zh: 大楼外面有一个年轻男子在闲逛。

sentences.en: They didn't recognise him, and as it was almost 11 o'clock at night, his presence seemed suspicious.
sentences.zh: 他们不认识他，而且当时已经快晚上11点了，他的出现显得十分可疑。

sentences.en: The concerned residents decided to approach the stranger.
sentences.zh: 这几位热心的居民决定上前接近这个陌生人。

sentences.en: They greeted the young man and asked what he was doing in the neighbourhood, when suddenly he pulled out a pistol.
sentences.zh: 他们向这个年轻人打招呼，询问他在附近做什么，突然他掏出了一把手枪。

sentences.en: If you value your lives, you'd better run for it, he warned.
sentences.zh: 他警告说：“如果你们还想要命的话，最好快跑。”

sentences.en: The trio wasted no time.
sentences.zh: 这三个人没有浪费时间。

sentences.en: As they bolted away from the young man, they heard a shot ring out behind them.
sentences.zh: 当他们从年轻人身边飞奔逃离时，听到身后传来一声枪响。

sentences.en: Luckily, none of them were struck by the bullet.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，他们中没有人被子弹击中。

sentences.en: Another resident later reported that the young man had also fired at him, sniper style.
sentences.zh: 另一名居民随后报告说，该年轻人也曾像狙击手一样向他开枪。

sentences.en: Flagging down a nearby police officer, the trio explained what had happened and jumped in the patrol car to track down the shooter.
sentences.zh: 这三人在路边截停了一名警察，说明了情况并跳上巡逻车去追踪枪手。

sentences.en: It didn't take long.
sentences.zh: 这并没有花太长时间。

sentences.en: They soon spotted the young man crossing Mission Boulevard and the officer turned his car around to give chase.
sentences.zh: 他们很快发现那个年轻人正在穿过米讯大道，警官随即将车调头展开追捕。

sentences.en: Realising he was being pursued, the shooter ran towards a nearby hotel and vanished into the night.
sentences.zh: 意识到自己正在被追捕，枪手跑向附近的一家酒店，消失在夜色中。

sentences.en: The policemen radioed for backup, prompting other officers to descend on the scene.
sentences.zh: 警察用无线电呼叫增援，促使其他警员涌向现场。

sentences.en: Together, they began scouring the grounds of the hotel, their flashlights cutting through the darkness.
sentences.zh: 他们一起开始搜查酒店的各处场地，手电筒的光束划破了黑暗。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a shot rang out from the direction of the hotel's wedding chapel.
sentences.zh: 突然，从酒店婚礼小教堂的方向传来一声枪响。

sentences.en: The shooter had fired at his own right temple with a .38 calibre pistol, which lay nearby.
sentences.zh: 枪手用一把放在身旁的.38口径手枪朝自己的右太阳穴开了一枪。

sentences.en: A driver's licence identified the man as 24-year-old Wayne David Chandler.
sentences.zh: 通过驾照确认该男子为24岁的韦恩·大卫·钱德勒。

sentences.en: He was transferred to hospital but died hours later.
sentences.zh: 他被送往医院，但在数小时后死亡。

sentences.en: Chandler's death was unwelcome news to the detectives fronting the swindle investigation.
sentences.zh: 钱德勒的死对负责斯温德尔调查案的侦探们来说是个令人沮丧的消息。

sentences.en: After learning what Chandler had done, he'd become a suspect in their case.
sentences.zh: 在得知钱德勒所做的事之后，他已经成为了他们案件中的一个嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Now, they were unable to question him to determine whether he had any involvement at all.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们无法对他进行讯问，以确定他是否真的参与其中。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Ocean Beach, business had dried up after the double homicide.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在欧申比奇，由于双重谋杀案的发生，生意一落千丈。

sentences.en: With locals and tourists alike fearing the shooter would return.
sentences.zh: 当地居民和游客都担心枪手会卷土重来。

sentences.en: Merchants offered a $700 reward for information leading to the arrest of the swindle's killer, hoping to speed up a conviction and draw back crowds.
sentences.zh: 商家悬赏700美元征集线索，以协助将斯温德尔案的凶手绳之以法，希望能加快定罪并吸引人群回流。

sentences.en: But years passed and the bounty went unclaimed.
sentences.zh: 但多年过去了，这笔赏金一直无人认领。

sentences.en: The evening of Sunday, October 30, 1966, two years after the murders of Johnny and Joyce Swindle, in Riverside, California.
sentences.zh: 1966年10月30日，星期日傍晚，即约翰尼和乔伊斯·斯温德尔在加利福尼亚州里弗赛德遇害两年后。

sentences.en: Eighteen-year-old Sherry Jo Bates grabbed a pen and paper and scribbled a quick message.
sentences.zh: 18岁的雪莉·乔·贝茨抓起一支笔和一张纸，快速写了一行字。

sentences.en: Dad went to RCC Library.
sentences.zh: 爸爸去了RCC图书馆。

sentences.en: She placed the note where her father would see it when he returned home from his trip to the beach.
sentences.zh: 她把字条放在父亲从海滩回来时一眼就能看到的地方。

sentences.en: Sherry Jo then left home in her most prized possession, her lime green 1960 Volkswagen Beetle.
sentences.zh: 随后，雪莉·乔驾驶着她最珍贵的财产——那辆石灰绿色的1960年大众甲壳虫汽车离开了家。

sentences.en: The first year Riverside City College student had taken great pride in the fact that she'd managed to buy the little car all by herself, with money saved from a part-time job.
sentences.zh: 这位里弗赛德城市学院的大一新生感到非常自豪，因为她完全靠自己兼职工作的积蓄买下了这辆小车。

sentences.en: Shortly after 6pm,
sentences.zh: 傍晚6点刚过，

sentences.en: Sherry Jo arrived at the RCC Library alone, leaving her beloved Volkswagen parked 30 yards down the road on Teresina Drive.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔独自一人到达了RCC图书馆，将她心爱的大众汽车停在30码开外的特雷西纳大道上。

sentences.en: Young and beautiful were the words that came to mind as he watched the petite co-ed with dark blonde hair and striking green eyes walk towards the library building.
sentences.zh: 当他看着这位有着深金发丝和迷人绿眼睛、身材娇小的女大学生走向图书馆大楼时，脑海中浮现出“年轻漂亮”这个词。

sentences.en: Once she was out of sight, he turned his attention to her car.
sentences.zh: 一旦她消失在视线之外，他便将注意力转向了她的汽车。

sentences.en: A lime green Volkswagen Beetle.
sentences.zh: 一辆石灰绿的大众甲壳虫。

sentences.en: Working swiftly under the cover of darkness, he opened the Volkswagen's rear compartment where its engine was located.
sentences.zh: 他在夜色的掩护下迅速行动，打开了大众汽车位于后部的发动机舱。

sentences.en: He removed the distributor coil and condenser, then took hold of the distributor's middle wire and tore it out before lowering the trunk shut and slinking away.
sentences.zh: 他拆下了分电器线圈和电容器，接着抓住分电器的中间导线将其扯断，然后砰地关上行李箱盖，悄悄溜走了。

sentences.en: He then made his way to the library, where he spotted the Volkswagen's owner studying alone.
sentences.zh: 随后他前往图书馆，在那里发现了正在独自学习的大众汽车车主。

sentences.en: He watched and waited until she stood from the desk, collected her books and headed outside.
sentences.zh: 他默默观察并等待着，直到她从书桌旁站起来，收好书本并朝外走去。

sentences.en: He let two minutes pass before taking off after her.
sentences.zh: 他等了两分钟才动身追了上去。

sentences.en: Sherry Jo Bates climbed into the driver's seat of her Volkswagen.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔·贝茨坐进了大众汽车的驾驶座。

sentences.en: Tossing her pocketbook and the three library books she'd borrowed onto the passenger seat, she then inserted her keys into the ignition and turned them.
sentences.zh: 她把钱包和借来的三本图书馆书籍扔到乘客座椅上，然后将钥匙插入点火开关并转动。

sentences.en: Nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 什么也没有发生。

sentences.en: She tried again.
sentences.zh: 她又试了一次。

sentences.en: Still nothing.
sentences.zh: 依然毫无反应。

sentences.en: For some unknown reason, her car wouldn't start.
sentences.zh: 由于某种未知的原因，她的车发动不起来了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a man appeared at Sherry Jo's window.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个男人出现在雪莉·乔的车窗旁。

sentences.en: Acknowledging her car troubles, he offered to help.
sentences.zh: 他注意到了她的汽车故障，主动提出帮忙。

sentences.en: He said that his car was down the street and he'd be happy to give her a lift.
sentences.zh: 他说他的车就在街那头，很乐意载她一程。

sentences.en: Sherry Jo accepted the kind offer and followed the man as he headed away from the library.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔接受了这份好意，跟着那个男子朝远离图书馆的方向走去。

sentences.en: They soon reached a gravel alleyway between two houses that led to a car park.
sentences.zh: 他们很快来到了一条连接两栋房屋、通往停车场的小石子巷道。

sentences.en: As the man guided Sherry Jo down the dark and quiet alley, he abruptly remarked,
sentences.zh: 当那名男子引导雪莉·乔走入这条黑暗而安静的小巷时，他突然开口说道：

sentences.en: It's about time.
sentences.zh: 是时候了。

sentences.en: Confused, Sherry Jo asked,
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔感到困惑，问道：

sentences.en: About time for what?
sentences.zh: 什么到时候了？

sentences.en: The man turned to her,
sentences.zh: 男子转过身看着她：

sentences.en: About time for you to die.
sentences.zh: 是你去死的时候了。

sentences.en: He launched at Sherry Jo and pressed one hand over her mouth while holding a small knife to her neck with the other.
sentences.zh: 他猛扑向雪莉·乔，一只手捂住她的嘴，另一只手拿着一把小刀抵住她的脖子。

sentences.en: Sherry Jo fought back and the pair fell to the ground mid-struggle.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔奋起反抗，两人在撕扯中摔倒在地。

sentences.en: She scratched at his face and tore at his hair.
sentences.zh: 她拼命抓挠他的脸，扯拽他的头发。

sentences.en: Sherry Jo managed to let out a desperate scream before he kicked her in the head to silence her.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔设法发出了一声绝望的尖叫，随后他踢了她的头部让她闭嘴。

sentences.en: He then plunged his knife into her chest over and over, causing it to break, before finally cutting her throat.
sentences.zh: 接着他一次又一次地将刀刺入她的胸膛直到刀身断裂，最后割断了她的喉咙。

sentences.en: I am not sick, he told himself.
sentences.zh: 我没有生病，他对自己说。

sentences.en: I am insane.
sentences.zh: 我是个疯子。

sentences.en: Cleophas Martin was used to rising early for work.
sentences.zh: 克利夫帕斯·马丁习惯了早起工作。

sentences.en: He was employed by Riverside City College as a groundskeeper and it wasn't unusual for him to begin his shift at the crack of dawn.
sentences.zh: 他受雇于里弗赛德城市学院担任地勤人员，在破晓时分开始轮班对他来说是常有的事。

sentences.en: When Cleophas arrived at the college in the early hours of Monday October 31, the area was deserted.
sentences.zh: 当克利夫帕斯在10月31日星期一的清晨到达学院时，四周空无一人。

sentences.en: By around 6.30, he was driving his street sweeper along Teresina Drive on the north side of the campus library.
sentences.zh: 大约6点30分，他正驾驶着清扫车沿着校园图书馆北侧的特雷西纳大道行驶。

sentences.en: Cleophas approached the alley that led to the student parking area.
sentences.zh: 克利夫帕斯接近了通往学生停车区的小巷。

sentences.en: It ran between two large, vacant houses owned by the college.
sentences.zh: 它位于学院拥有的两栋大型空置房屋之间。

sentences.en: He glanced down the alley and caught sight of something bundled up on the ground towards the rear of the houses.
sentences.zh: 他朝小巷里瞥了一眼，发现在房屋后部附近有一团东西裹在地上。

sentences.en: It was a young woman lying face down in the dirt.
sentences.zh: 那是一个面朝下趴在泥土里的年轻女性。

sentences.en: Beneath her torso was a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 在她躯干下方是一滩血迹。

sentences.en: Police arrived at the scene and examined the woman.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到现场并检查了这名女性。

sentences.en: She was fully dressed in red capri pants, a yellow blouse and white sandals.
sentences.zh: 她身着红色的卡普里裤、黄色衬衫和白色凉鞋。

sentences.en: Dry leaves were tangled in her dishevelled dark blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 她蓬乱的深金发丝间缠绕着枯叶。

sentences.en: Her body had been stabbed with a small knife upwards of 42 times, with lacerations found on her face, hands, arms, chest and back.
sentences.zh: 她的身体被一把小刀刺了42次以上，面部、双手、手臂、胸部和背部均有撕裂伤。

sentences.en: The most violent wound was to her neck, which had been so viciously cut that she was almost decapitated.
sentences.zh: 最严重的一处伤在她的脖子上，伤口被极其残忍地割开，几乎将她斩首。

sentences.en: There was no sign of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 没有性侵的迹象。

sentences.en: Pressed beneath her was a straw tote bag.
sentences.zh: 压在她身下的是一个草编手提袋。

sentences.en: Papers inside featured the name
sentences.zh: 里面的纸张上写着

sentences.en: Sherry Jo Bates.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔·贝茨的名字。

sentences.en: Scuff marks in the gravel indicated that
sentences.zh: 砾石上的擦痕表明

sentences.en: Sherry Jo had tried to flee, while foreign skin scrapings underneath her fingernails proved she had put up a fight.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔曾试图逃跑，而她指甲下的外源性皮屑证明她进行过反抗。

sentences.en: There were also four blood-soaked, sandy brown hairs stuck to her right thumb.
sentences.zh: 她的右大拇指上还粘着四根浸血的沙棕色毛发。

sentences.en: Forensic testing limitations meant that only one key feature about the hairs could be ascertained.
sentences.zh: 由于法医检测的局限性，关于这些毛发只能确定一个关键特征。

sentences.en: They had come from a white male.
sentences.zh: 它们属于一名白人男性。

sentences.en: One student reported seeing a man standing in the shadows of the alley where Sherry Jo's body was later found.
sentences.zh: 一名学生报告说，看到一名男子站在小巷的阴影里，雪莉·乔的遗体后来就是在那里被发现的。

sentences.en: He was smoking a cigarette and staring fixedly at a lime-green
sentences.zh: 他当时正在抽烟，直勾勾地盯着一辆青柠绿色的

sentences.en: Volkswagen parked nearby.
sentences.zh: 大众汽车，它停在附近。

sentences.en: The student had managed to take in some of his features, estimating his age to be 19 or 20 and his height about 5 foot 11.
sentences.zh: 这名学生设法记住了他的一些特征，估计他年龄在19或20岁左右，身高约5英尺11英寸。

sentences.en: She'd exchanged a brief greeting with him before continuing on her way.
sentences.zh: 她与他简短地打了个招呼，然后继续往前走。

sentences.en: Sherry Jo's unlocked Volkswagen was found on nearby
sentences.zh: 雪莉·乔没锁的大众汽车在附近的

sentences.en: Teresina Drive with the keys still in the ignition.
sentences.zh: 特雷西娜大道被找到，钥匙还插在点火开关里。

sentences.en: Her pocketbook and textbooks remained on the passenger seat.
